wizard.typeWebsiteDesc: Crawl any public URL and index the text content.
wizard.typeDocumentDesc: Upload a PDF, TXT or CSV file.
wizard.crawlModeHint: Controls how pages are fetched and processed.
wizard.modeSoupDesc: Fast HTTP fetch — no browser. Best for static sites.
wizard.modePlaywrightDesc: Headless browser — handles JS-rendered sites. Gemini understands the content automatically.
wizard.infoWebsite: We send a crawler to the URL you provide and index the text content into your chatbot's knowledge base. Choose Soup for fast static sites, Playwright for JS-heavy sites, or Playwright + LLM for the best chunk quality.
wizard.infoDocument: Upload a PDF, TXT or CSV and we extract and index the text content automatically.

wizard.triggerDesc: The trigger is a topic or intent that activates this rule. When a user asks something matching this, your instruction kicks in. Keep it short and descriptive.
wizard.actionDesc: Tell the bot exactly what to say or do when this trigger is matched. Be specific — e.g. 'Direct the user to our pricing page at example.com/pricing for all pricing questions.'
wizard.actionExample: e.g. 'Always direct the user to example.com/pricing for pricing questions.'
